data.name: Down to Earth
data.description: Down to Earth (formerly Norsk Karbonlagring AS) was founded in spring 2021 by Bjørnulf Tveit Benestad together with Jesper and Johan. The Norwegian company delivers biochar-based carbon removal by sourcing biochar and placing it at customer rooftop gardens, farms in their value chain, or in construction materials — a carbon removal service with physical delivery, with all removals leading to verified carbon credits from an internationally recognized carbon removal registry. They also operate a global program with partners like Carboneers in India/Ghana.
